embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
fields.value: ByteDance Seed (listed among the paper's affiliations; exact per-author mapping not recoverable from the HTML, affiliation fields were blank — PhysLoop is a harness in which an LLM agent writes a physics task/scene program that Unreal Engine (with Taichi/Genesis support) simulates, a verifier checks the simulated result, and a video model (Seedance 2.5 by default) renders appearance on top — building a training/repair pipeline for physical

fields.name: Neural Render Proxies for Interactive and Differentiable Lighting
fields.value: Disney Research|Studios (flag) — The paper introduces a method for interactive, differentiable relighting of static scenes (fixed camera, fixed materials) by decoupling path sampling from emission computation.

fields.name: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
fields.value: Roblox (listed affiliation block; other listed affiliations are UC Merced, UPenn, UT Austin) — The paper presents PixVid, which adapts a pretrained latent video diffusion model (Wan2.1-14B) to generate video directly in pixel space instead of a compressed VAE latent space.

fields.name: VibePrevisBench: Evaluating Agentic Coding for 4D Scene Generation in Blender
fields.value: Kuaishou — The paper introduces VibePrevisBench, a 242-task benchmark that asks coding agents to turn a text/photo/video brief into an executable 4D scene in Blender and render a proxy ("previs") video.

fields.name: Topology-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Egocentric Videos
fields.value: Google; Google) — The paper introduces TopoEgo, a benchmark of egocentric video clips with topology-changing object interactions (cutting, assembly, opening, closing), and Topo-4DGS, a 4D Gaussian Splatting method built to handle those topology changes.

fields.name: MatrixSplat: Matrix-Parallel and Feature-Scalable 3D Gaussian Splatting Rendering on GPUs
fields.value: Snap Inc.; other co-authors are from UT Arlington, UT Dallas, University of Georgia, and Argonne National Laboratory) — MatrixSplat re-engineers 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) rendering to better use GPU Tensor Cores, replacing the standard sequential depth-sorted alpha-compositing with an order-independent weighted accumulation expressible as matrix operations.

fields.name: RF3DGS: Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting with Self-Priors
fields.value: Huawei Research; **FLAG: borderline** (Huawei is not on the core tracked list — RF3DGS removes reflections from 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions by exploiting the fact that, across multiple views of the same 3D point, the darkest pixel is usually reflection-free.

fields.name: FlashMotion: Ultra-Fast Long-Term 3D Motion Generation
fields.value: Tencent — FlashMotion is a framework for generating long 3D human motion sequences — text-to-motion, music-to-dance, and speech-to-gesture — under a tight inference budget.

fields.name: Camera3R: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Heterogeneous Camera Models
fields.value: Google; Ruxiao Duan and Alex Wong are dual-affiliated with Yale University) — Camera3R is a low-rank adaptation (LoRA) framework that extends feed-forward 3D reconstruction networks pretrained on perspective images to other camera models (fisheye, panoramic) without full retraining.

fields.name: BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model
fields.value: NVIDIA; Seungryong Kim is listed with KAIST — BirdDreams is an autoregressive driving world model that generates a perspective (camera-view) video and a schematic bird's-eye-view (BEV) video jointly, so scene layout is part of the prediction rather than inferred implicitly.

fields.name: Spaghetti Splatting: Differentiating Curvilinear Dirac Masses via Convolution
fields.value: Wayve Labs — The paper introduces "Spaghetti Splatting," a method for learning curve-like (curvilinear) 3D primitives directly from images via differentiable volume rendering, extending the convolution-based formulation used in EWA splatting and 3D Gaussian Splatting to one-dimensional, infinitely-thin geometry.

fields.name: PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation
fields.value: Alibaba; footnote states the work was done at ATH@Alibaba Group) — PhysOPSD is a framework for making video-generation models physically plausible by using executable simulation code as a "privileged" physical context during on-policy distillation, rather than relying on supervised fine-tuning or sparse physics-based RL rewards.

fields.name: Budget-aware Correspondence-driven View Selection for Real-time 3D Perception of Mobile Robots
fields.value: Amazon — The paper introduces BCVS, a pose-free, correspondence-driven view-selection algorithm that runs at over 22 FPS on CPU to filter redundant frames from image sequences for real-time 3D perception on mobile robots.

fields.name: From Game Generation to Game Playing: Fully Automated Ability Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
fields.value: Roblox — The paper presents a framework that uses an LLM-powered coding agent to automatically build game environments, tasks, and scripted expert players from natural-language skill descriptions, which then generate keyboard-and-mouse demonstrations without any human gameplay data.
